onEnter.message: Freddista, losing her patience, grabs you and hurls you through the entrance! You crash onto the warm steel plates, surrounded by the steam of boiling pasta.

description: A true pasta paradise! Hundreds of ramen packets, Mac and Cheese packets, noodle packets, and even Indomie line the shelves. A grand staircase spiraled upward into two other floors, wrapped in a large golden railing embedded with noodles. The air is warm and smells of boiling broth.

exit_west.description: A dark crawlspace leading back to the Hidden Hideout.

steel_wall.description: Thick steel-plated walls that vibrate with heavy machinery.

metal_floor.description: Polished metal floor plates, slightly slippery from condensation.

noodle_vats.description: Giant boiling vats filled with premium Indomie, steaming ramen, and delicious Mac and Cheese! The noodles look incredibly tempting.

item.name: Spicy Noodles
item.description: Exotic and very spicy noodles from the factory. Hot enough to melt ice!
item.opened_description: The vats are boiling, but no more spicy noodles can be safely scooped.

onUse.successMessage: You collected some Spicy Noodles! The fiery aroma makes your eyes water!

chef_tortellini.description: A chef wearing a white hat, frantically stirring a pot.

trades.name: Mushrooms for Potato
trades.description: Trade 2 Glowing Mushrooms for a fresh Wild Potato (+5 HP).

trades.name: Pollen Starch Boost
trades.description: Process 3 Yellow Pollen into a starch soup to permanently increase Max HP by 2.

trades.name: Trade for Stable Footing

ability.name: Stable Footing
ability.description: Your incredible balance allows you to walk safely on jiggly jelly surfaces.

trades.description: Trade a Pulsing Vine to learn the passive 'Stable Footing' ability (prevents jelly launching).

dialogue.text: "The recipe must be exact! No mistakes! Starch is the secret to all life!" Chef Tortellini shouts frantically.

assembly_belt.description: A grand staircase spiraling upward to the upper floors, with a large golden railing embedded with noodles. Shelves of pasta packets line the stairs.

jammed_valve.description: A large steam valve that has rusted shut. It refuses to turn.
